issues: 旧景是灰底上一个调试字「BEFORE」，没有纸、没有墨，介质隐喻无从谈起
渗边只是遮罩的硬切口：新景直接从锯齿洞里露出来，没有墨色、没有湿晕，读作破洞而不是墨
没有落墨的起点，洇开凭空开始
新景从第一帧就是最终尺寸，缺少「显影」的过程感
工作台时长被推断成 80f，摘罩后的 30f 静止收尾被截掉
changes: 旧景换成暖白纸面章节扉页：等宽章号 + 112px 衬线标题（斜体强调）+ 细线 + 副题，铺静态纸纹颗粒（不换帧，静止段像素恒定）
墨做成三层同源须状遮罩：+110px 重羽化湿晕（0.12）→ 墨边外沿（领先 20–42px，0.42 + 3.2px 羽化）→ 墨芯（0.86 + 1px 羽化），新景在墨后显影
14–22f 先落一个小墨点（overshoot 缓动），再被洇开的墨边吞没
新景在遮罩内 scale 1.035→1（ease-out，100f 精确归 1）做显影收束；保留原半径曲线、±8% 扰动与 100f 摘罩
补导出 INK_BLEED_REVEAL_DURATION = 130（洇开 20–98f + 摘罩后真静止 30f）
issuesEn: The old scene was a debug word "BEFORE" on gray — no paper, no ink, so the medium metaphor had nothing to stand on
The bleed was just a hard mask cut: the new scene showed through a jagged hole with no ink color or wet halo, reading as a tear rather than ink
There was no ink drop — the bleed started out of nowhere
The new scene was at final size from the first frame, with no sense of developing
The workbench inferred 80f, cutting off the 30f hold after the mask is removed
changesEn: The old scene is now a chapter title page on warm paper: mono chapter number, 112px serif title with italic emphasis, rule and subtitle, over static paper grain (no re-roll, so held frames stay pixel-identical)

Ink is three masks sharing the same tendril displacement: a +110px heavily feathered wet halo (0.12) → an outer ink fringe leading by 20–42px (0.42, 3.2px feather) → a dense core (0.86, 1px feather); the new scene develops behind the ink
A small ink drop lands first (14–22f, overshoot ease) before the bleed swallows it
Inside the mask the new scene settles from scale 1.035→1 (ease-out, exactly 1 at 100f) as a develop-in; the original radius curve, ±8% wobble and 100f mask removal are kept
Exported INK_BLEED_REVEAL_DURATION = 130 (bleed 20–98f + 30f true hold after unmasking)
